-- Name -- coverage (domain and range representation)
-- Definition -- Coverage which provide the domain and range as separate properties.

tag.name: byValuePropertyType
tag.value: false#NOTES#Values: false Default: false Description: Create a property type that requires that the instance is encoded inline (applies to ISO 19136:2007 encoding rule). Always set to false in INSPIRE.

documentation.value:
-- Name -- coverage function
-- Definition -- Description of how range values at locations in the coverage domain can be obtained.

-- Name -- domain set
-- Definition -- Configuration of the domain of the coverage described in terms of coordinates.
-- Description -- NOTE The values of this property will typically be constrained in subtypes to specific spatial and/or temporal geometries.

-- Name -- range set
-- Definition -- Set of feature attribute values associated by a function with the elements of the domain of the coverage.

constraint.name: gridFunctionRequiresGridDomain
constraint.description: /*The grid function shall only be valid for domains that are grids */ inv: coverageFunction.gridFunction.notEmpty() implies domainSet.oclIsKindOf(CV_Grid)

properties.documentation:
-- Name -- coverage function
-- Definition -- Description of how range values at locations in the coverage domain can be obtained.
-- Description -- NOTE The following variants are currently supported: a mapping rule either by inline text or by reference and a grid function that specifies the sequence of the grid points.

documentation.value:

-- Definition -- Mapping rule for grid geometries.

-- Name -- rule definition
-- Definition -- A formal or informal description of the coverage function as text.

-- Name -- rule reference
-- Definition -- A formal or informal description of the coverage function as reference.

properties.documentation:
-- Name -- grid function
-- Definition -- An explicit mapping rule for grid geometries

documentation.value:
-- Name -- sequence rule
-- Definition -- Description of how the grid points are ordered for association to the elements of the values in the range set of the coverage.

-- Name -- start point
-- Definition -- The grid point to be associated with the first record in the range set of the coverage.
-- Description -- If startPoint is omitted it is assumed to be equal to the lowest values in the envelope of the grid geometry.

properties.documentation:
-- Name -- rectified grid coverage
-- Definition -- Coverage whose domain consists of a rectified grid
-- Description -- A rectified grid is a grid for which there is an affine transformation between the grid coordinates and the coordinates of a coordinate reference system.
NOTE This type can be used for both discrete and continuous coverages.

constraint.description: /*The domain shall be a rectified grid.*/ inv: domainSet.oclIsKindOf(CV_RectifiedGrid)
